detailedNarrative: CASE037 (FIR/AMBALACANT/2025/0037) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Ambala Cantt, Ambala. Incident recorded on 2025-05-28 11:46 at Ambala City Residential Colony. FIR records 2 accused (Meena Bansal P00176, Sandeep Sharma P00411) and 5 named persons in total. 980 records across 5 sources; 18 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN005012 → EVD-TXN005014, 15.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. Account UTIB-52701713023 received funds from 4 different individuals within 14 days.
